claims.statement: Groups may bid jointly without taking a special legal form solely to submit the offer, and may appoint a representative or lead partner.

Pooled licenses, qualifications, and experience must be tied to the member performing the work that requires them, and reliance on another entity's resources must establish actual tender-specific access.

Polish joint bidders bear joint and several responsibility for performance and performance security; statutory maxima can expose a medium contract to bid security up to 3% and performance security generally up to 5%.

A consortium formed for a scope its members cannot undertake individually is the clearest competition-law case; joint bids among firms capable of independent bids require case-specific assessment and minimum-necessary information exchange.
Tender discovery and basic partner matching are not scarce: official Polish platforms provide free BZP/TED search and subscriptions plus a consortium partner-finding module.

Current Polish policy seeks greater SME and local-firm participation and recommends faster payments, advances, and partial payments, creating supportive context but no automatic award or financing right.
The viable control point would have to be verified deployable capacity and delivery governance, because tender alerts, partner discovery, and nationwide turnkey installation are already available.
Installer commitment, buyer acceptance, win rate, take rate, guarantee pricing, working-capital need, and contribution margin remain unobserved.

contrary_evidence: r7-s1 imposes real member-performance, resource-access, joint-liability, and security constraints rather than allowing a coordinator to aggregate credentials on paper.
r7-s3 warns that joint tendering among firms able to bid independently can restrict competition and that information sharing must be necessary.
r7-s5 and r7-s6 make tender alerts and generic partner discovery free official utilities rather than defensible paid features.
r7-s8 demonstrates direct competition from an established nationwide turnkey EPC provider.
